When a user presses <kbd>Tab</kbd> on a command-line option typed as [`click.Choice`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/types.py#L309), Click resolves the completion candidates through the following callpath:

### 1. Shell Hook Invocation
* **File & Symbol:** [`_SOURCE_BASH`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/shell_completion.py#L105-L135) (or [`_SOURCE_ZSH`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/shell_completion.py#L143-L185) / [`_SOURCE_FISH`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/shell_completion.py#L187-L207))
* **Action:** The shell's registered completion function executes the CLI program in a subshell, passing environment variables:
  * `_{PROG_NAME}_COMPLETE=<shell>_complete` (e.g., `_MYCLI_COMPLETE=bash_complete`)
  * `COMP_WORDS`: The full command string tokens entered so far.
  * `COMP_CWORD`: The index of the word currently being completed.

---

* **Action:** Resolves the completion variable name (e.g., `_MYCLI_COMPLETE`), inspects `instruction = os.environ.get(complete_var)`, and invokes [`shell_complete(...)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/shell_completion.py#L19-L56), exiting the process with `sys.exit(rv)` upon return.

* **File & Symbol:** [`src/click/types.py:Choice.shell_complete`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/types.py#L437-L458)
